args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Versions
< 2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 is the first fixed release in the 2.x
line, so this pins fastjson to 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. All versions < 2.9.4 are affected, so this pins to 2.9.4 — the first fixed release in the 2.x line.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
